routes.name: Tarzan
routes.desc: Tree climb, old access to 'Humanality'.
routes.setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

routes.name: Eviction
routes.desc: All titanium bolts (P1: 12 bolts, P2: 7 bolts).

routes.name: Eviction (Variation)
routes.desc: Splits to the left about halfway up P1. All titanium bolts (P1: 9 bolts, P2: 7 bolts).

routes.name: Bird's Nest Drop
routes.desc: Access by the first pitch of 'Humanality'. Then left of P2. Old stainless steel glue-in bolts. Do not climb!

routes.name: Humanality
routes.desc: Could be 5, 6 or 7 piches, depending how you see the climb. Start up the ladder, left of 'Cowabungalow'. Climb up behind a stalactite and traverse left to the anchor on the ledge. 1 titanium bolt, 4 slings. Straight up the stalactite and right to the anchor on the cave of the next ledge. 4 titanium bolts. Traverse outwards to the right. Straight up on the face. Anchor to the left on a small ledge above the 'Bird's Nest Drop' anchor. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Straight up into the tufas to a big belay ledge. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Up and right under the big stalactite formation. 6 titanium bolts, 5 slings. Up the wall to the right of a big structure. 3 titanium bolts, 4 slings. Old pitch that traverses left on threads. Dangerous and never climbed. With a single 60m rope, it's one short rappel from the top of pitch 6 to the top of pitch 5, then three raps to separate abseil anchors. If you have a 70m rope, you can rap straight from the top of pitch 6 to the next set of anchors.

routes.name: Human Frality
routes.desc: Trad climb, which was used to open 'Humanality'.

routes.name: Open Project
routes.desc: Unfinished project on the short wall below P1 of 'Humanality'. About 8a or higher. Now behind the small shack right of the Freedom Bar.

routes.name: Planet Ton Sai
routes.desc: On the short wall below P1 of 'Humanality', now covered by the small shack right of the Freedom Bar.

routes.name: I No Speak England
routes.desc: Starts at the platform of the Freedom Bar. Crux is right at the start. 5 stainless steel glue-in bolts, 6 slings. Stick-clip the 2nd bolt to avoid hitting the platform on a lead fall!

routes.name: Cowabungalow
routes.desc: The leftmost line on the terrace right of 'Humanality'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Super Liam
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Cowabungalow', then right towards the small cave. Be careful with loose rock in the upper part. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Sweating Mekong
routes.desc: Short crux about halfway. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Viking in Heat
routes.desc: Head up the ladder then straight up the wall, which gets increasingly overhanging. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Ya Rup Rup
routes.desc: Squeezed just right of 'Viking in Heat'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Hin Rong Hai
routes.desc: Do not skip the crux by going right towards the anchor -- only 6b then and risk of breaking the fragile tufas. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Big Guy Loosing the Cat
routes.desc: The leftmost line on the upper terrace. Shares anchors with 'Silkcat'. 3 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Silkcat
routes.desc: Shares the first two clips with 'Tom Yum' and anchors with 'Big Guy Loosing the Cat'. 2 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Tom Yum
routes.desc: Big moves on big holds. Getting polished, but still worth climbing. Shares the first two clips with 'Silkcat', then up right. 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Trade Winds
routes.desc: 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Dry Net
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: On the Terrace
routes.desc: Starts on the very right edge of the upper terrace. Start is a little hard to read. 5 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

routes.name: For You & For Me
routes.desc: Crawling through the corner on the very left side of the roof. 1 titanium bolts, 6 slings. Careful, anchors not equipped with rings. Do not lower through the slings!

routes.name: Riesenbaby
routes.desc: Stiff start up to the cauliflower, then traverses right on the rails. Nice moves, though very polished. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

routes.name: Spanish Wreck
routes.desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Wasps/Hornets Shares anchors with 'Dragon Ball' and 'Old Chicken Makes a Good Soup'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Dragon Ball
routes.desc: Very Dynamic climbing. Good fun! Shares anchors with 'Spanish Wreck' and 'Old Chicken Makes a Good Soup'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Old Chicken Makes a Good Soup
routes.desc: Original grade 8a. Upgraded after breakage of a stalactite. Shares anchors with 'Spanish Wreck' and 'Dragon Ball'. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Hang Ten
routes.desc: Original grade 7c. Upgraded after breakage of a stalactite in 2006. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Tidal Wave
routes.desc: Very popular and very polished, short and powerful with a tendency to spit you off with sloppy beta. Make sure your belayer is paying attention otherwise you could end up with a mouth full of sand. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Baby Gorilla
routes.desc: Original grade 7b+. Upgraded due to a broken hold. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Sunrise West Way
routes.desc: Old stainless steel glue-in bolts. Do not climb!

routes.name: Angle Couple
routes.desc: Old stainless steel glue-in bolts. Do not climb!

routes.name: Tantrum
routes.desc: The Tonsai beach classic! Get on it. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: World Peace
routes.desc: Closed Old route just left of 'Cafe Andaman', sharing the top section with 'Tantrum'. this is a dumb line of bolts with no holds.
warnings: Closed Old route just left of 'Cafe Andaman', sharing the top section with 'Tantrum'.

routes.name: Cafe Tantrum
routes.desc: Linkup. Start with 'Cafe Andaman', then continue on the traverse and finish on the anchors of 'Tantrum'.

routes.name: Café Andaman
routes.desc: Climbs straight up the obvious tufa, then traverses left. Finishes in the small cave next to the anchor. Top section can seep after rain. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Ton Sai Love Story
routes.desc: Old route, sharing the start with 'Ton Sai Playboy', but going up into the left roof after the 3rd clip. Rusty expansion bolts, anchors seem to have been removed. Cannot be climbed anymore.
warnings: Rusty expansion bolts, anchors seem to have been removed.

routes.name: Ton Sai Playboy
routes.desc: Very popular, easy start to pumpy roof climbing. Just keep moving all the way to the anchors! Very fun! A bit harder now, after holds broke recently. Take the left line after the fourth bolt, or you end up in 'Playboy Connection'. Titanium bolts and slings.

routes.name: Playboy Connection
routes.desc: Linkup. Start at 'Ton Sai Playboy' and continue right after 4th bolt to join 'Mafia Connection'. Often confused with 'Tonsai Playboy' as this route is missing in most guidebooks. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Mafia Connection
routes.desc: Starts just left of 'Love for Travelling', finishes on the anchor just right of 'Ton Sai Playboy'. Tricky start, pumpy finish. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Mafia Lover
routes.desc: Linkup. Finish variation after the early crux. Veers right after the 3rd bolt and joins 'Love for Travelling' just below the small roof. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Love for Travelling
routes.desc: Very nice line that, for some reason, gets much less attention than the popular and always busy 'Lal Bab' or 'Babes in Thailand', although it is just as good. A bit of an awkward stemming start to get onto the thick stalactite. Then some nice 3D climbing, which is easier than it looks once you've sorted out the beta. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Just Dusit
routes.desc: Shares the first bolt with 'Germans in Tights', then left. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Germans in Tights
routes.desc: Shares the first bolt with 'Just Dusit', then right. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Second Home Ton Sai
routes.desc: Another great line that is often overlooked and sees by far not as much traffic as many of the "classics" in the roof. Bouldery start, then fight the pump to the anchors. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Beauty and the Beast
routes.desc: Closed The route has been closed and the crux bolts removed (see comments). The original description is preserved for posterity: Awesome route !!! A little bit psycho when you must fall on the tufa. Seems to be 6c for people under 1.70m, for the other 6a+. But, you should do this route!!!
warnings: Closed The route has been closed and the crux bolts removed (see comments).

routes.name: Stalagasaurus
routes.desc: Original grade 6a+. Upgraded after breakage of a huge stalactite in 2004. Good climbing apart from the broken section, which wrecks the flow. Still fun and still worth it. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Babes in Thailand
routes.desc: Popular climb on pinches and jugs. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Sex Power
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Lal Bab
routes.desc: Early crux, followed by big powerful moves on jugs in the first half, then much easier and less steep to the top. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Elephant
routes.desc: 4 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Banshee
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Cream of Tom Yum Kai'.

routes.name: Cream of Tom Yum Kai
routes.desc: Too much fun for one climb. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Ant Jump
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Voodoo Doll
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Phet Maak
routes.desc: A real classic of the area. Originally graded 8a and still is if you go direct, nowadays most people head out right to the large tufa midway essentially avoiding the crux. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Cara Cangreso
routes.desc: All titanium bolts. Shares anchors with 'Czech Open'.

routes.name: Czech Open
routes.desc: Start variation to the right of 'Cara Cangreso' and share anchor. Joins on the headwall. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Gaeng Som Pla
routes.desc: Another Tonsai beach classic! Starts on the crack right of 'Czech Open'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Down Flyer
routes.desc: Starts 5m right of 'Gaeng Som Pla', straight through the steep grey roof into the structured rock below the anchor. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Speak No Evil
routes.desc: Traverse following the crack and the ledge on the roof. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier, 2010

routes.name: Kun Suk Khoo
routes.desc: Traverses left along the upper crack in the roof, right and above 'Speak no Evil'. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Ymer Alber, Björn Alber & Henrik Bolander, 2015

routes.name: First Blood
routes.desc: The furthest line to right behind the bushes. Traverses left along the edge of the roof. All titanium bolts.
